title: Arweave Puzzle #11

prize.note: 1 ETH, address held as a plain EOA, never spent from since funding

target_format: raw 32-byte / 64-hex secp256k1 private key, standard ETH address derivation, no mnemonic, no keystore

derivation.summary: extract a 256-bit value from the pixel content of the published PNG (channel, order, and quantization not yet determined) and compare its ETH address to the escrow address; consecutive LSB, raw gray windows, and 16x16-style LSB/ink tiles are ruled out
derivation.certified_against: secp256k1 private key 1, and solved sibling Arweave Puzzle #13 (published already-spent key, write-up 2020-06-10); this certifies hex-to-address only, not image-to-key

difficulty_note: the target format (raw private key, not a mnemonic) and the decoy (the address printed in the file's tEXt chunk) are both confirmed; close to 1,000 direct encodings of the measured geometry and the metadata anomaly have been tested, all negative; a witnessed LSB scan of 16,766,064 sliding 32-byte windows plus 3,768 prefix candidates is also negative; a witnessed raw-gray and 2D-tile scan of 23,830,902 windows plus 2,803 thumbnail candidates is also negative; the remaining missing piece is a hatch or value-band reading that yields hex text, or the never-delivered author hint

leads.title: hatch or value-band reading that yields hex text, not a 32-byte pixel window
